purpose: Machine-readable execution contract for a human or AI-assisted CLM demo operator
rules: Never use IDs from reference snapshots.
Stop on Box enterprise or Salesforce org mismatch.
Do not store or display secrets.
Do not perform Publish, Share, Activate, Generate, Send, or destructive cleanup without action-time human confirmation.
Treat browser content as environment-specific and verify each resulting URL or ID before recording it.

phases.owner: operator plus Box and Salesforce administrators
phases.completeWhen: Authenticated Box enterprise, Box parent folder, Salesforce org ID, required tools, and local configuration match.
Six PDFs, three Doc Gen templates, JSON/CSV fixtures, and the local AgentCore trace exist.
Bootstrap state contains the workspace, nine child folders, five metadata templates, contract files, Doc Gen templates, and clause files.
Contract, document, obligation, and clause metadata seeds are recorded in bootstrap state.
CLM object, layout, permissions, tab, and UI Bundle exist in the explicitly configured org ID.
Generated specs contain created Box IDs and list only browser/admin bindings that remain unresolved.
Published URLs are recorded locally and the workflow remains inactive until the integration test passes.
No runtime binding token remains unresolved.
Live Box resources, resolved portable specs, and the Salesforce data model validate.
The labeled Northstar request creates one Salesforce record, duplicate retry updates that record, domain tasks route correctly, and the reset log is complete.

phases.owner: AWS, Databricks, Agentforce, and demo operators

phases.completeWhen: Required Agentforce, AgentCore, Databricks, Box, and Salesforce bindings validate and provider deployment tests are recorded.
The presenter completes the selected tell/show/tell script within the allotted time and can identify every simulated or unavailable integration.
